description: Defines the interface for WifiManager in the WPEFramework plugin, including method signatures for Wi-Fi operations and event callbacks.

classes.name: WifiManagerInterface
classes.description: Abstract class defining Wi-Fi management operations and events within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi quirks based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing2
methods.description: Starts an alternative WPS pairing process.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID to preferred list.

methods.name: clearSSID
methods.description: Removes an SSID from preferred list.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Gets detailed info about the paired SSID.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled.
